summary.intent: Advance the monokl code-search tool by finalizing the rg-compare eval harness (PR #56) and starting two default-behavior fixes (lossy non-UTF-8 reads, parent ignore files), while deciding how and when to evaluate whether a weaker model (Haiku) benefits from the tool.
summary.outcome: PR #56 was pushed with targeting and output-size scoring and its checks now pass (including Entire Gates). Two agents were launched for the non-UTF-8 and parent-ignore PRs but had not reported back; model-in-the-loop evals were deferred.

repo: `just rg-compare` is a deterministic, zero-cost harness that scores monokl against rg: the declaration is in the top 3 for 39 of 41 identifiers, and output is ~10x smaller than `rg -n`.
The harness does not measure multi-call questions or whether a weaker model finds the answer; that requires a separate model-in-the-loop eval.

Planned model eval design: fixed questions per pinned repo with known answers; arms are Haiku+monokl, Haiku+rg, Sonnet+rg; measure correctness, turns and tokens; pass if Haiku+monokl matches Sonnet+rg correctness at fewer tokens.
Model evals cost API calls, so they should run on demand, not in CI.
Entire Gates is a CI check tied to Entire trails (e.g. trail 236); it can show 0 findings and no failure reason, and it may be stale against an earlier commit.
Repo uses changesets: the agent PRs add patch changesets, and PR #55 carries a library-only minor changeset; releases are held for user-visible work.
Branches for the new work: `fix/non-utf8-lossy-read` and `fix/parent-ignore-files`; the PRs run `just lint` and `just test`.
workflow: Launching independent small PRs as parallel agents works when the tasks touch separate areas; the orchestrator should not claim results until the agents report back.
When a CI check fails with no diagnostics, check whether it ran against a stale commit before dismissing or chasing it; here it passed on the new commit.
Keep the cheap deterministic harness as the per-change check and defer costly model evals until the numbers stop moving.
